case_level_notes: Standard 45-day extension scenario with proper modification and timely results notice.

determinations.rationale: No consumer statement filed; dispute was resolved by modification.
CRA reviewed consumer info, compared furnisher response, considered primary documents, and reached a finding.
Furnisher notified within 3 business days with relevant info; later relevant info forwarded.
Consumer disputed completeness of an item in the file via direct notice with adequate packet.
Completed in 43 days; additional relevant info received in initial 30 days extends deadline to 45 days.
Valid dispute packet identifying consumer, account, disputed field, and basis.
No direct dispute to furnisher in this case; not applicable.
All applicable CRA, furnisher, timing, treatment, and notice duties were satisfied.
No frivolous termination invoked; not applicable.
Furnisher investigated, reviewed info, reported results, modified item, and reported to other CRAs within deadline.
No identity theft, mixed file, missing documents, conflicting dates, or manual policy trigger present.
Item found incomplete, modified appropriately, and current status recorded.
Dispute was direct to CRA; no reseller involved.
Written results sent within 5 business days with required disclosures inferred from ordinary-course packet.
